decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper on protein sequences, but the evidence only supports biological sequence language modeling, not a natural-language text component. The model predicts protein structure/function from amino acid sequence and does not describe a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "self-supervised pre-training LMs on an unlabeled big dataset (UniRef50...)"; "predict aspects of protein structure ... and function ... from amino acid sequence alone"
